summary: A woman (~75) fell off a ledge near Little Dolores Falls ("the Potholes"), Glade Park; bystanders started CPR; deputies and park rangers continued CPR but she was pronounced deceased; Mesa County SAR recovered her body.
location: Little Dolores Falls ("the Potholes"), Glade Park, Mesa County
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, National Park Rangers, Grand Junction Fire Dept, Glade Park Fire Dept, Mesa County SAR, CareFlight
notes: Reported 2:40pm May 24, 2025; identity/cause to Mesa County Coroner's Office.
